{{Top|leg}}
The '''Flyway 120''' was a flyway on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. The flyway could be entered at [[Cloud Bridge]]. The flyway ran west from Cloud Bridge and along that path the flyway intersected with the [[Rift Skyrail|Harvest Flyway]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]] used Flyway 120 to get to [[Griann]].
